suggestions.expectation: session-file.md has Outcome and Open at end written (no _(fill in)_ on either line) and its Narrative mentions this closing
suggestions.reason: As worded this passes on any non-placeholder text. This run filled Outcome/Narrative with a docs review that never happened (transcript reads only OVERVIEW.md) and it would pass a placeholder-absence check. Sharpen to require that Outcome/Narrative claim nothing the transcript does not show — e.g. 'Outcome describes only work evidenced in transcript.md; where no work preceded the close it says so (or asks)'. That is the outcome the skill's 'as things actually ended' and CLAUDE.md 'verify or say unverified' care about, and it discriminates honest closes from confabulated ones.

No expectation covers the skill's end step 1 (`bun run session -- --session SES-NNN` → 'up to date') or step 4's `gh pr list` / say-so-if-skipped. Both were silently skipped here with no consequence because the fixture had no commits and a local origin. A fixture with one unlogged commit in the session would make step 1 discriminating; an expectation that transcript.md shows the append run (or the gh skip stated) would catch this.

The 'reply.md ... states what shipped' expectation passes on an inflated Shipped line ('reviewed the full docs system'). Consider tying it to the session file: Shipped names only commits/PRs present in git-state.txt's log for this conversation, plus no claims absent from the Changes section.

eval_feedback.overall: Mechanics (gate, clean tree, no push/PR, SES-005 untouched, OVERVIEW unchanged) are well covered and all verified in the fixture. The content-honesty gap is the one that matters: the run confabulated a completed review into Outcome/Narrative and only the loosest reading of expectation 1 catches it.
